description: Tom follows up on the honest conversation opened in tick 6. He asks Priya direct questions about the AV and commercial fleet liability pivot at AutoShield: Is there a real licensing track? Does she know agents who have made the transition? What does the structure actually look like? He comes as a genuine thought partner, not a managed professional maintaining appearances. He tells her the sector data plainly — 22 policies, trend declining — and asks for her honest read, not the version she'd give management.
expected_outcome: Information exchange — Priya's ground-level read on whether the commercial pivot is a real transition path or corporate noise. Possible referral to specific licensing resources or colleagues who have made the transition. Trust deepening between two colleagues facing the same structural pressure.
contingency: If Priya has no useful intelligence on the commercial pivot, the conversation still has value as a genuine check-in between two people in the same shrinking sector. No downside to showing up honestly.
